details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) introduced new rules, "Regulation Crypto Assets," on August 18, 2026. This proposal aims to create a clear regulatory framework for investment contracts involving crypto assets, including exemptions for capital raises up to $75 million annually without full securities registration. It also features a conditional safe harbor mechanism, building on previous guidance to foster capital formation while protecting investors.
title: SEC Proposes "Regulation Crypto Assets" for Clearer Framework

details: Bitcoin briefly climbed above $81,000, reaching a high of $81,280 on August 25, 2026, before a slight pullback to around $79,800. This surge is attributed to renewed spot demand and significant institutional interest, with U.S.-listed spot Bitcoin ETFs recording approximately $1.92 billion in net inflows last week, marking their strongest weekly performance in about 10 months. Analysts are watching if Bitcoin can sustain above $80,000 for a potential further bullish trend.
title: Bitcoin Surpasses $80K, Driven by Strong ETF Inflows

details: Ethereum (ETH) has experienced mixed market sentiment. While derivatives showed a slight slip into negative territory over the past week, there's evidence of significant whale accumulation, with one notable wallet withdrawing 112,000 ETH for staking. U.S. spot ETH exchange-traded funds (ETFs) also recorded $53.7 million in net inflows recently. Additionally, Bitmine Immersion Technologies acquired 32,447 ETH, further boosting its holdings to roughly $11 billion.
title: Ethereum Sees Mixed Signals, Whale Accumulation & ETF Inflows
